about_the_game:
Code. Battle. Compete.

In Botomy, you don’t control your hero with buttons — you write their brain.

Program your bot’s skills and strategies using real code, then send it into battle against players from around the world. Level up, unlock powerful abilities, and climb the global leaderboards in two thrilling game modes:

Free For All Mode – Compete in different maps to optimize your bot’s decisions and logic. Highest XP wins the match.

Survival Mode – Battle against endless waves of enemies. Work together with other players to outsmart, outlast, and out-code.

Features:

• Power Up Your Bot – Equip special attacks like Freeze, Bomb, and Shockwave

• Kill Streak Rewards – Power up with Speed, Attack, Health, and Super Mode

• Skill Tree Customization – Build your bot’s identity with Speed, Health, and Attack upgrades

• Global Leaderboards – Track your progress and rise through the ranks

• Practice Offline – Test your bot before going live

• Choose Your Language – Program in your preferred coding language, starting from a customizable template

Whether you’re a beginner or a seasoned coder, Botomy is a fresh new way to level up your programming skills while battling for glory.

Can your bot reach level 30?

Additional System Requirements: You must have a developer/coding environment to run your own code to control your character. See more at

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Linux distribution released after 2016
  • Processor: x86_64 CPU
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with full Vulkan 1.0 support (e.g. Intel HD Graphics 5500 (Broadwell), AMD Radeon R5 Graphics (Kaveri))
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 250 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Local development environment (e.g. nodejs, python, etc)

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.15
  • Processor: x86_64 or ARM CPU (Apple Silicon)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal 3 support
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 350 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Local development environment (e.g. nodejs, python, etc)

  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
